text:
Situation: Oxytocin has been on FDA's drug shortage list since 2022-09-23 and remains listed as of 2026-10-21, a duration of 49 months. Current inventory across Corvale East and Corvale General ranges from 7.6 to 16.5 days of supply depending on product and site.

Why (FDA record): FDA posted the oxytocin shortage on 2022-09-23. A registered plant on our product labels, Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (FEI 1450022), received an OAI classification after an inspection ending 2022-06-30, 85 days before the shortage posting. The same plant had an earlier OAI inspection ending 2020-05-18 with observations on sterile procedures and batch records. A second registered plant for the same labeler (FEI 3001833549) has OAI inspections ending 2011-07-08 and 2013-01-11. Both plants received VAI classifications in 2023, after the shortage posting.

Our position: We are purchasing from the rule-selected vendor, Cardinal Health 107, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today. P&T approved an interchange to an alternate concentration from Par Health USA, LLC (NDC 42023011602) on 2026-04-16.

Recommended actions:
1. Continue purchasing oxytocin from Cardinal Health 107, LLC as the primary source (buyer approves).
2. Maintain REMEDYREPACK INC. and West-Ward Pharmaceuticals Corp as secondary and tertiary purchase options, neither on FDA's shortage list today (buyer approves).
3. Use the P&T-approved alternate concentration from Par Health USA, LLC with pharmacist verification for dose and volume recalculation (pharmacist approves).
4. Retain the Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC alternate concentration approved 2026-01-24 as a backup with pharmacist verification (pharmacist approves).

Not recommended: Do not rely on current Fresenius Kabi inventory as a stable primary source given the plant inspection history and prolonged shortage listing.
